title: 2.1 Task Definition
use_cases: Implement when defining the mathematical objective functions for style transfer models
Use when evaluating the trade-off between semantic preservation and style accuracy
Configure when setting up Toward and Away optimization targets for training
Use when distinguishing between individual and community style labels in a dataset
